culprit_citations.quoted_text: Unless otherwise indicated, issuers of debt and equity investments held by the Company ... are denominated in dollars.

findings.detail: The holding has fair_value_currency extracted as EUR, but the March 31, 2023 investment schedule states debt and equity investments are denominated in dollars unless otherwise indicated; EUR appears only in reference-rate or borrowing-facility text.

rationale: FX02 is a real data error. The flagged extracted value is fair_value_currency=EUR, while the raw March 31, 2023 schedule note says investments are denominated in dollars unless otherwise indicated. The evidence search found EUR only in EURIBOR reference-rate disclosures and Barclays borrowing-facility text, not as an investment fair-value denomination. The stored EUR therefore reflects an extraction/unit leak rather than the source fair-value currency.
